_comment: AUTO-GENERATED — PARTIAL endpoint with 15 params | Enriched 2026-03-02 | Descriptions updated 2026-06-03
description: Just-in-time admin management API endpoint. This function can create users, add roles, remove roles, delete, or disable a user.

add_params.name: AdminRoles
add_params.description: Array of admin roles to assign. LabelValue shape: { "label": "Role Display Name", "value": "<ObjectId>" }. The value must be the role's ObjectId (GUID). Retrieve available roles from GET /api/ListRoles?TenantFilter=<tenant>.

add_params.name: Domain
add_params.description: Domain for the new user's UPN. Required when userAction="create". Accepts a LabelValue object ({ "label": "contoso.com", "value": "contoso.com" }) or a plain domain string. PS1 unwraps .value with fallback to the raw string.

add_params.name: EndDate
add_params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) for when the JIT access expires. The scheduler removes/disables the user at this time per ExpireAction.

add_params.name: existingUser
add_params.description: Target user when userAction="select". LabelValue shape: { "label": "User Display Name", "value": "<UPN or ObjectId>" }. If value is a GUID (ObjectId), the PS1 resolves it to a UPN automatically via Graph. Required when userAction="select".

add_params.name: ExpireAction
add_params.description: Action to perform when JIT access expires. LabelValue shape: { "label": "...", "value": "<action>" }. Valid values: "DisableUser" (disable the account), "DeleteUser" (permanently delete), "RemoveRoles" (userAction=select only), "RemoveGroups" (userAction=select only), "RemoveRolesAndGroups" (userAction=select only). Accepts a plain string instead of a LabelValue object.

add_params.name: FirstName
add_params.description: First name for the new user. Required when userAction="create".

add_params.name: GroupMemberships
add_params.description: Array of groups to add the user to. LabelValue shape: { "label": "Group Display Name", "value": "<ObjectId>" }. The value must be the group's ObjectId (GUID). Used when ExpireAction includes group removal.

add_params.name: jitAdminTemplate
add_params.description: Template to pre-populate defaults from. LabelValue shape: { "label": "Template Name", "value": "<GUID>" }. Retrieve available templates from GET /api/ListJITAdminTemplates?TenantFilter=<tenant>.

add_params.name: LastName
add_params.description: Last name for the new user. Required when userAction="create".

add_params.name: PostExecution
add_params.description: Notification actions to trigger after JIT access is granted. Array of strings. Valid values: "Webhook", "email", "PSA".

add_params.name: reason
add_params.description: Justification text for why JIT access is being granted. Stored on the JIT admin record.

add_params.name: StartDate
add_params.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) for when JIT access begins. Defaults to immediate if omitted.

add_params.name: tapLifetimeInMinutes
add_params.description: Lifetime of the Temporary Access Pass in minutes. Only used when UseTAP=true. Must be within the tenant's TAP policy limits. Omit to use the tenant default.

add_params.name: tenantFilter
add_params.description: Target tenant domain or GUID. Required.

add_params.name: userAction
add_params.description: Whether to create a new user or target an existing one. "create" requires FirstName, LastName, username, Domain. "select" requires existingUser.

add_params.name: usageLocation
add_params.description: Usage location for the new user (required by Microsoft for license assignment). LabelValue shape: { "label": "Country Name", "value": "<ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code>" } — e.g. { "label": "Canada", "value": "CA" }. Accepts a plain country code string. Only used when userAction="create".

add_params.name: username
add_params.description: Username prefix (without domain) for the new user. Combined with Domain to form the UPN. Required when userAction="create".

add_params.name: UseTAP
add_params.description: If true, generates a Temporary Access Pass instead of a password for the new user. Only applicable when userAction="create".

notes: Parameters extracted from: api, frontend. Verified and promoted to high confidence. GroupMemberships and usageLocation and tapLifetimeInMinutes added 2026-06-03 — were present in PS1/frontend but missing from sidecar. ExpireAction valid values sourced from frontend add.jsx. Duplicate Username/Reason entries removed (covered by username and reason params).
